title: Snatch Craft, Sharp Finish
format: EMOM 12 (every 90 sec) + For Time · 9 min cap
workout: A. Every 90 sec x 8 sets (12 min)
1 Snatch pull + 1 Hang power snatch + 1 Overhead squat
Build to a heavy but crisp complex
B. 3 Rounds For Time (9 min cap)
scaling: Complex: drop the overhead squat, or use a PVC pipe or empty bar for technique.
Wall balls: lighter ball or lower target. Pull-ups: ring rows or banded pull-ups.
Run: swap for 250 m row or 12/9 cal bike if needed.
stimulus: Part A is about bar path and speed under the bar, not grinding. Part B is short and sharp: move fast, but keep your breathing under control on the run.
strategy: Add load only when every rep is fast and the bar stays close.
Run at 85%, so you can attack the wall balls right away.
Split wall balls 6-6 and pull-ups 4-4 or 5-3. Rest briefly.

levels.name: Rx
levels.text: As written. Heavy but crisp complex, full snatch pull, hang power snatch and overhead squat.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.text: Complex at 30/20 kg · 65/45 lb. Wall balls 6/4 kg · 14/9 lb. Banded pull-ups.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.text: PVC or empty bar, drop the overhead squat. 150 m run, 10 wall balls, 8 ring rows.

caption:
Thursday is for the bar. Make it fast, make it clean. 💪

A. Every 90 sec x 8 sets (12 min)
1 Snatch pull + 1 Hang power snatch + 1 Overhead squat
Build to a heavy but crisp complex. Start ~35/25 kg · 75/55 lb.

Rest 3 min, then:

B. 3 Rounds For Time (9 min cap)
200 m Run
12 Wall balls (9/6 kg · 20/14 lb)
8 Pull-ups

Scaling:
- Complex: drop the overhead squat, or use a PVC pipe or empty bar.
- Wall balls: lighter ball or lower target. Pull-ups: ring rows or banded pull-ups.
- Run: 250 m row or 12/9 cal bike.

Coach note: Part A is about bar path and speed, not grinding. Add load only when every rep is crisp. Part B is short and sharp. Run at 85%, split the wall balls and pull-ups early, and keep moving.

Injured or unsure? Scale it and talk to a coach or doctor.

title: Handstands and Hustle
scaling: Handstand: pike hold with feet on a box, or a wall plank hold.
Ring rows: walk feet back to make them easier. Keep feet low for less load.
Lighten the KB and DBs, and lower the box. Stay smooth.
stimulus: Part A is quality over quantity. Stay fresh, stack the line, and stop a hold before form breaks. Part B is a steady, moderate piece. Keep moving and aim for even rounds.
strategy: Part A: stop each hold while the position is still clean.
Break ring rows early, 5-5, before your grip fades.
Aim for the same round time every round.

levels.name: Rx
levels.text: As written. Holds of 30 sec, ring rows with feet elevated, loads as listed.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.text: Hold 20 sec (wall or chest-to-wall). Rows feet on floor. KB 16/12 kg, DB 15/10 kg.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.text: Pike hold on box 20 sec. Rows standing at an incline. KB 12/8 kg, DB 10/7.5 kg, low box.

caption:
Skill first, then sweat. Midweek is for getting upside down. 🔥

A. Skill · EMOM 10 min
Odd: 20-30 sec wall-facing handstand hold
Even: 10 Hollow rocks

Rest 3 min, then:

B. AMRAP 12 min
10 Ring rows (feet elevated)
12 KB swings (24/16 kg · 53/35 lb)
12 Alt. DB step-ups (22.5/15 kg · 50/35 lb), box 50/40 cm · 20/16 in

Score A = best hold time. Score B = rounds + reps.

Scaled options:
- Handstand: pike hold with feet on a box, or a wall plank hold.
- Ring rows: walk your feet back to make them easier, or keep them low for less load.
- Lighten the KB and DBs and use a lower box.

Coach note: Part A is quality over quantity. Stop each hold before form breaks. Part B is a steady, moderate piece. Pick a pace you can hold for all 12 minutes and keep the rounds even.

If you have an injury or you're unsure about a movement, scale it and check with a coach or doctor.

title: Steady Engine Builder
workout: Hold the same pace for all 24 min
scaling: Swap the run for a 15/12 cal Echo bike and use lighter DBs (12.5/7.5 kg · 30/15 lb).
Use 30 single-unders or 60 sec of jump-rope pace work. Shorten the run to 150 m if legs are fried.
stimulus: This is an aerobic engine builder. You should be able to move the whole 24 minutes without stopping for long. Keep the run and row at about 75% effort and take short, planned breaks on the push press.
strategy: Run easy. Legs are likely still tired from yesterday's squats.
Row smooth and long. Don't sprint the calories.
Break the push press early: 5-5 or 4-3-3. Don't fail reps.

levels.name: Rx
levels.text: As written: 200 m run, 12/10 cal row, 20/12.5 kg DBs, 40 single-unders.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.text: 150 m run, 10/8 cal row, DBs 15/10 kg (35/20 lb), 40 single-unders.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.text: 100 m run or 10/8 cal bike, 8 push press at 10/7.5 kg (25/15 lb), 30 single-unders.

caption:
Tuesday is engine day. Settle in, find a rhythm, and hold it for 24 minutes. 💪

AMRAP 24 min:
200 m Run
12/10 cal Row
10 DB push press (20/12.5 kg · 45/30 lb)
40 Single-unders (or 20 Double-unders)

Score = rounds + reps.

Scaled options:
- Swap the run for a 15/12 cal Echo bike and use lighter DBs (12.5/7.5 kg · 30/15 lb).
- Use 30 single-unders and shorten the run to 150 m if your legs are tired.

Coach note: This is an aerobic piece. Run and row at about 75% effort, and break the push press early so you never grind. Same pace in minute 24 as in minute 4.

If you have an injury or aren't sure about a movement, scale it and talk to a coach or doctor.

title: Heavy Five, Quick Eight
workout: Build to a heavy set of 5 (RPE 8-9)
Then 1 set of 8 at ~80% of your heavy 5
scaling: Toes-to-bar: hanging knee raises or knees-to-chest
Squat: keep 1-2 reps in reserve, use a box or pause for depth
Burpees: step back instead of jumping, no push-up
stimulus: Part A is a smooth, honest build to a heavy but clean set of 5. No grinding, no form breaks. Part B is a short burner: ride hard, break T2B early, keep burpees steady.
strategy: Squat: add weight in steady jumps, save your best for the top.
Bike at 80%, not 100%. You need your grip for T2B.
Break T2B early: 4-4 or 3-3-2. Never fail reps.

levels.name: Rx
levels.text: Heavy 5 at RPE 8-9, then 8 reps at ~80%. T2B and jumping burpees as written.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.text: Heavy 5 at a load you own. Alternate T2B with hanging knee raises.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.text: Goblet or empty-bar squat 3x8 to a box. Knee raises, step-back burpees, bike 8/6 cal.

caption:
Monday means heavy. Build it, then burn it. 🔥

HEAVY FIVE, QUICK EIGHT

A. Back squat · 20 min
- Build to a heavy set of 5 (RPE 8-9)
- Then 1 set of 8 at ~80% of your heavy 5
- Rest 2-3 min between work sets

Rest 3 min, then:

B. AMRAP 8 min
- 10/8 cal Assault/Echo bike
- 8 Toes-to-bar
- 8 Burpees

Scaling:
- Toes-to-bar: hanging knee raises or knees-to-chest
- Squat: keep 1-2 reps in reserve, use a box or pause for depth
- Burpees: step back instead of jumping, no push-up

Coach note: Part A is a smooth, honest build to a heavy but clean set of 5. No grinding, no form breaks. Part B is a short burner: bike at 80%, break T2B early, keep burpees steady. 💪

New to heavy squats, or dealing with an injury? Scale it and talk to a coach or doctor.

title: Sunday Reset Flow
workout: Choose bike, row or easy jog
1 min Dead hang or easy scap pull
2 min Easy breathing, lie on back
scaling: Short on time? Do A for 12 min and one round of B and C.
Swap the run for a walk if legs are heavy from Saturday.
Skip any position that causes pain and ask a coach or doctor.
stimulus: No intensity today. Heart rate stays low, movement stays smooth, and you finish feeling better than you started. Keep it conversational the whole way.
strategy: If you can't talk in full sentences, slow down.
Move through ranges slowly, no forcing end positions.
Spend extra time on the tightest spots, not the easy ones.

levels.name: Rx
levels.text: As written: 20 min Zone 1-2, then 2 rounds of B and C.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.text: 15 min easy bike or row, then 2 rounds of B, 1 round of C.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.text: 10-15 min easy walk or bike, 1 round of B and C. Hold stretches lightly.

caption:
Recovery is part of the program. Today we move easy and reset. 💪

SUNDAY RESET FLOW
Active recovery · 40 min easy

A. 20 min easy aerobic, Zone 1-2
Bike, row or easy jog. Nose breathing, full sentences.

B. 2 Rounds, no rush:
10 Cat-cow
8/side Thoracic rotations
10 Air squats, slow tempo
30 sec/side Couch stretch

C. 2 Rounds:
1 min Dead hang or easy scap pull
1 min Pigeon pose per side
2 min Easy breathing, lie on back

Scaled options:
- Short on time? Do A for 12 min and one round of B and C.
- Swap the run for a walk if legs are heavy.
- Skip any position that causes pain. If you're injured or unsure, scale it and talk to a coach or doctor.

Coach note: No intensity today. Keep your heart rate low and your movement smooth. Finish feeling better than you started.

title: Tag Team Grind
format: Partner · 3 Rounds For Time · 32 min cap
workout: Teams of 2 · one works, one rests
30 Alt. DB reverse lunges (22.5/15 kg · 50/35 lb)
Split reps any way you like
Only one partner works at a time
scaling: Double-unders: 100 single-unders or 50 penguin jumps.
Swings: lighter bell, 16/12 kg · 35/26 lb. Lunges: bodyweight.
Not sure about a movement or have an injury? Scale it and talk to a coach or doctor.
stimulus: A steady, sustainable grind, not a sprint. Aim for about 9-10 min per round. Keep each work block short so your partner gets real rest and the pace holds for all 3 rounds.
strategy: Split swings in sets of 10 and lunges in sets of 6-8.
Swap before you slow down. Quick, clean handoffs win.
Run the 200s hard but controlled. Save your legs for the lunges.

levels.name: Rx
levels.text: As written: double-unders, 24/16 kg swings, 22.5/15 kg DBs.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.text: 16/12 kg KB, 15/10 kg DBs, 100 single-unders, 3 rounds.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.text: 12/8 kg KB, bodyweight lunges, 100 singles, 2 rounds, 250 m row for each 200 m run.

caption:
Saturday means team day. One works, one rests, and you both earn it. 🔥

TAG TEAM GRIND
3 Rounds For Time (32 min cap), teams of 2:
400 m run (each partner runs 200 m)
50 Double-unders
40 KB swings (24/16 kg · 53/35 lb)
30 Alt. DB reverse lunges (22.5/15 kg · 50/35 lb)
40 Sit-ups
Split reps any way you like. Only one partner works at a time.

Scaled options:
- Double-unders: 100 single-unders or 50 penguin jumps
- Swings: 16/12 kg · 35/26 lb. Lunges: bodyweight
- Beginner: 2 rounds, 250 m row instead of each 200 m run
Injured or unsure? Scale it and talk to a coach or doctor.

Coach note: This is a steady grind, not a sprint. Aim for about 9-10 min per round. Keep your sets short, swap before you slow down, and save your legs for the lunges. 💪

title: Pull, Row, Press
workout: Score = total time (or reps completed at the cap)
scaling: Pull-ups: banded or ring rows (feet elevated for a harder option).
Push-ups: hands on a box or bar, or standard push-ups.
Row: drop to 10/8 cal, or 4 rounds.
stimulus: A fast, upper-body-driven triplet. Legs stay fresh after yesterday's lifting and box work, so the pace comes from your breathing and grip. Aim for a steady 2–3 min per round with no long stops.
strategy: Row hard but smooth: leave some air for the pull-ups.
Break pull-ups early: 4-4 or 3-3-2. Don't hang to failure.
Push-ups in sets of 6. Quick reset, then go again.

levels.name: Rx
levels.text: As written: 12/10 cal row, 8 pull-ups, 12 hand-release push-ups, 5 rounds.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.text: 4 rounds. Banded pull-ups, standard push-ups, row 10/8 cal.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.text: 3 rounds. Ring rows, push-ups from a box, row 8/6 cal.

caption:
Friday means a clean triplet and a clock. Pull, row, press. Go. 🔥

5 Rounds For Time (15 min cap):
12/10 cal Row
8 Pull-ups
12 Hand-release push-ups

Scaled options:
- Pull-ups: banded or ring rows
- Push-ups: hands elevated on a box or bar
- Row: 10/8 cal, or cut to 4 rounds

Coach note: This one is fast and upper-body heavy. Your legs get a break after yesterday. Aim for 2–3 min per round and keep the pace steady. Break pull-ups early (4-4 or 3-3-2), keep push-ups in small sets, and row hard but smooth. Injured or unsure? Scale it and talk to a coach or doctor.

title: Crisp Bar, Fast Feet
workout: B. 3 Rounds For Time (9 min cap)
Rest 3 min between A and B
scaling: A: Power clean from the hang with a push press instead of the jerk, or use a lighter, fixed load.
B: Step up onto the box instead of jumping. Use lighter DBs, or do 6 snatches per round.
Unsure about a movement or carrying an injury? Scale it and talk to a coach or doctor.
stimulus: Part A is about technique under mild fatigue. Build over the 12 minutes and stop adding load if bar speed or positions slip. Part B should feel like a hard, steady sprint: go unbroken on the bike, then move smoothly on the snatches and jumps.
caption:
Thursday = barbell day. Get crisp, then get fast. 🔥

A. EMOM 12 min
1 Hang power clean + 1 front squat + 1 push jerk
Build the load across the 12 minutes. Start around 40/30 kg · 90/65 lb and only add weight if reps stay clean.

Rest 3 min.

B. 3 Rounds For Time (9 min cap)
12/9 cal Assault/Echo bike
8 Alternating DB snatches (22.5/15 kg · 50/35 lb)
10 Box jump-overs (60/50 cm · 24/20 in)

Scaled options:
A: Hang power clean + push press instead of the jerk, or use a lighter fixed load.
B: Step up instead of jumping. Use lighter DBs or do 6 snatches per round.
If you have an injury or you're unsure about a movement, scale it and talk to a coach or doctor.

Coach note: Part A is technique under mild fatigue. Build smart and don't chase weight with sloppy reps. Part B is a hard, steady sprint. Hold a pace you can keep for all 3 rounds. ⏱️
